collection.title: Cupra (SEAT) Born 2021 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Cupra Born 2021 Onwards will fit, this model requires a 30" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Born which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
